Rivers State University Teaching Hospital Internship Details

Rivers State University Teaching Hospital (RSUTH) is currently accepting applications for its 2026 Internship Programme for healthcare graduates seeking mandatory professional internship training and clinical workplace experience.

The programme provides practical training, supervised clinical exposure, professional development, and hands-on experience within one of Rivers State’s leading tertiary healthcare institutions.

Apply seamlessly for internship and housemanship programs at RSUTH. Submit applications, upload required documents, and track your application progress all in one place.

RSUTH Internship Program 2026 Benefits

The RSUTH Internship Program offers the following benefits;

  • Practical clinical training and experience

  • Exposure to tertiary healthcare environment

  • Professional mentorship and supervision

  • Career development opportunity

  • Hands-on healthcare and patient management experience

  • Opportunity to fulfill professional internship requirements

Responsibilities of RSUTH Internship Program Interns

The interns will be responsible for:

  • Participate in structured clinical internship training

  • Support patient care and healthcare service delivery

  • Gain supervised practical experience within assigned departments

  • Work alongside experienced healthcare professionals

  • Develop clinical, technical, and professional competencies

  • Participate in healthcare operations and patient management activities

  • Maintain professional and ethical standards

Rivers State University Teaching Hospital Internship Requirements

To be eligible for the Rivers State University Teaching Hospital Internship, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

  • Must possess a recognized university degree in relevant discipline

  • Valid temporary or practicing license from appropriate professional regulatory body

  • Must meet internship requirements for chosen profession

  • Strong commitment to professional healthcare practice

  • Good communication and teamwork skills

Rivers State University Teaching Hospital Internship Required Documents

While applying for the Rivers State University Teaching Hospital Internship, you will be required to submit the following documents;

  • Application Letter

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)

  • Recent Passport Photograph

  • Professional License/Registration Certificate

  • Degree Certificate or Statement of Result

  • WAEC/NECO Certificate

  • First School Leaving Certificate

  • Local Government Identification Letter

  • Birth Certificate

  • Statutory Declaration of Age

  • Two Recommendation Letters

How To Apply for RSUTH Internship Program 2026

To apply for the RSUTH Internship Program 2026, follow the instructions we have outlined below; 

  • Read the information we have provided on this webpage and ensure your eligibility

  • Visit the Portal: Go directly to the RSUTH Application Portal

  • Select the RSUTH INTERNSHIP 2026 initiative from the list of available programs.

  • Register & Fill the Form: Input your personal data and complete the dynamic application form.

  • Upload Documents: Attach clear, scanned copies of your professional licenses and academic certificates.

  • Track Status: Submit your profile and use your dashboard to monitor application screening progress
